note: WAEC Literature-in-English Paper 1 round 1 (Round 16e): the WASSCE syllabus with FRESH angles - device-in-quotation items ('The lake slept quietly', 'sweet sorrow', 'pen is mightier'), specific African works and authors (Achebe, Soyinka, Adichie, Tutuola, Nwapa, Emecheta, Okri, p'Bitek, Rotimi, Ngugi), oral forms (oriki, dirge, riddle) and term-distinction items (tone/mood, aside/soliloquy, myth/legend) - because the near-dup scan checks every item against the JAMB, WAEC and NECO banks INCLUDING our 90-item NECO Literature bank. Topics: figures of speech, poetry, drama, prose, literary terms, African literature, oral literature.
